title: sarcostemma thunbergii
intro: Sarcostemma thunbergii, commonly known as Veldt grape or Horse's grape, is a species of flowering plant in the milkweed family Apocynaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, cough, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Sarcostemma thunbergii include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
